finding: Passing the source MemoryScope to detachOwnedRow did not reduce partition or evaluation peak reservations for a 20,000-character string. Both comparison tests measured zero improvement, while mutable byte isolation and cleanup still passed.
cause: MemoryScope.tryRetainAllocation indexes directly adopted values. A detached row is adopted as a composite owner indexed by row object; its nested scalar atomic allocations are not visible to that lookup. The same limitation applies when partial owners are adopted by fan-in.
decision: Removed the ineffective optional input-scope API and restored the tested implementation. Do not add per-row recursive ownership searches: that risks quadratic work.
nextImplementationRequirement: Build a bounded immutable-backing index once per input stage from trusted ownership provenance; retain selected backing independently, preserve opaque owner fallback, never share mutable byte buffers through scalar reuse, and measure both construction overhead and peak reduction.
scope: Investigation only; no runtime behavior change or benchmark speedup claimed.
